Install Health Connect to see your steps and sleep next to your doses.
Insights show what was recorded to help you notice patterns. They are not medical advice.
How Kairo uses your health data

Kairo reads your daily steps and sleep from Health Connect to show them next to the doses you took on the Insights screen.\n\nKairo only reads these two types of data. It never writes to Health Connect, never sends your data off this phone, and never shares it. You can disconnect at any time in Health Connect.
